text:
Anya: ok team — vendor sync at 11 PT. Main agenda: H100/H200/B200 kernel/slotting, MI300 delivery window, Gaudi image freeze, and press/marketplace handshake. who owns lab slots and embargo coordination?
Maria: I can own vendor comms + PR draft. can we confirm embargo windows before i call partners?
Leo: H100 kernels are green. B200 firmware has a risk flagged by hw team. lab can add 2 extra Gaudi nodes week of 4/15 if needed.
Sam: marketplace needs SKU tagging and compatibility matrix by 4/10 to hit listing timeline. who can push that?
Jade: ops can manage lab slots. note: power derate on Gaudi cluster earlier today, might affect perf numbers.
hw-bot: new firmware patch for B200 scheduled 2024-04-12. changelog: microcode+pci fixes. link: https://vendor.example/patch/4521
Maria: action items: @Leo send compatibility matrix (MI300/H200/Gaudi/B200) by EOD 4/8. @Anya confirm embargo dates with PR and partners. i'll draft joint statement template for review.
Anya: tentative embargo window 4/20-4/22. internal canary marketplace on 4/18. public announcement planned 4/21 08:00 PT.
Leo: uploading matrix now -> `s3://redwood/compat/mi300-gaudi-h200-2024-04.csv`
Sam: got the path, i'll wire it into marketplace pipeline. rollout plan: phase by region (US -> EU -> APAC) and set fallback model to open-weights-small for constrained regions.
Jade: ops note: add perf appendix saying Gaudi numbers measured with power derate. recommend including known variance in the marketplace performance card.
Maria: partners asked to avoid explicit supply constraint language. prefer "staged availability" + pre-order CTA.
Anya: decision: embargo 4/20 confirmed. public announce 4/21 08:00 PT. marketplace rollouts phased as above.
Sam: i'll add rollout policy to infra config: `region_priority: ['us','eu','apac']` and initial concurrency cap = 200 qps. will open a canary route on 4/18.
Leo: if MI300 shipment slips, fallback plan is to promote H200-verified variants; we've validated perf parity on the common prompt set.
Jade: ops checklist: image tags, driver versions, kernel builds, release-window oncall rota. i'll post runbook link after this thread.
Maria: please send a short blockers list by EOD. current: firmware risk (B200), Gaudi power variance, compatibility doc finalization. @hw-bot can you nudge vendor for microcode ETA?
hw-bot: ping sent to vendor_contacts@vendor.com, ticket created #INC-4521. will post updates to this thread.
Anya: perfect. reconvene tomorrow 9am PT for final gating review. :thumbsup:
